name: Pastel Bunny Amigurumi
description: Meet our adorable Pastel Bunny, handcrafted with ultra-soft premium cotton yarn. Perfect as a nursery companion, gift, or shelf decor. Each bunny has hand-embroidered facial details and is filled with hypoallergenic stuffing. Safety eyes used — suitable from age 3+.
materials: 100% premium cotton yarn (hypoallergenic), polyester fiberfill, safety eyes (age 3+)
care: Hand wash in cold water. Do not tumble dry. Reshape while damp and air dry flat.

name: Mini Elephant Buddy
description: Our chubby Mini Elephant Buddy is made with love using soft cotton-blend yarn. Great as a baby toy, bag charm, or a thoughtful gift. Choose from calming blue, silver gray, or rosy pink. Can be personalized with a name tag.
materials: Cotton-blend yarn, polyester fiberfill, safety eyes
care: Spot clean or gentle hand wash. Air dry only.

name: Bohemian Market Tote
description: Carry your world in this roomy Bohemian Market Tote. Handcrafted using 100% cotton macramé cord in an open-weave pattern, it is strong, stylish, and plastic-free. Perfect for the farmers' market, beach, or everyday errands. Holds up to 5 kg.
materials: 100% cotton macramé cord, wooden ring handles
care: Machine wash on delicate cycle. Reshape and air dry.

name: Crochet Mini Crossbody
description: The Crochet Mini Crossbody is the perfect accessory for a day out. Handcrafted in a dense shell-stitch pattern with an adjustable strap and magnetic snap closure. Fits your essentials — phone, cards, keys. Choose your colour!
materials: Premium cotton yarn, metal hardware, magnetic snap
care: Spot clean only. Keep away from water.

name: Sunrise Macramé Wall Hanging
description: Add a touch of bohemian warmth to any wall. This Sunrise Macramé Wall Hanging is hand-knotted from natural cotton rope using traditional macramé techniques. Comes with a smooth driftwood dowel. Makes a beautiful housewarming or wedding gift.
materials: 3mm natural cotton rope, driftwood dowel
care: Dust gently. Spot clean with a damp cloth only.

name: Boho Plant Hanger Set
description: Elevate your indoor garden with our Boho Plant Hanger Set. Each hanger is hand-knotted from natural jute twine in a swirling spiral pattern. Holds pots up to 20cm diameter. Perfect for succulents, ferns, and trailing vines.
materials: Natural jute twine, wooden beads
care: Keep away from excessive moisture. Dust regularly.

name: Chunky Wool Scarf
description: Wrap yourself in warmth with our Chunky Wool Scarf, crocheted in a cosy thick stitch using premium merino-blend wool. Incredibly soft against skin, naturally breathable, and warm enough for Indian winters. Available in seasonal colours.
materials: 70% merino wool, 30% acrylic blend
care: Hand wash in cool water with wool-safe detergent. Dry flat.

name: Slouchy Crochet Beanie
description: Our Slouchy Crochet Beanie is the perfect everyday hat — casual enough for errands, cosy enough for cool evenings. Handcrafted in a ribbed stitch for a snug fit with a relaxed top drape. Fits children and adults.
materials: Soft acrylic yarn (machine-washable)
care: Machine wash on cold gentle. Lay flat to dry.

name: Boho Crochet Crop Top
description: A festival-ready boho crop top handcrocheted in a floral granny-square motif. Lightweight cotton yarn keeps you cool and stylish. Pairs beautifully with high-waisted jeans or flowy skirts. Can be customised to your exact measurements.
materials: 100% mercerised cotton yarn
care: Hand wash only. Do not bleach. Dry flat in shade.

name: Newborn Baby Booties Set
description: Tiny toes deserve the softest yarn! Our Newborn Baby Booties are handcrafted from ultra-soft, skin-friendly cotton yarn. No synthetic fibers, no dyes, and 100% baby-safe. A beautiful baby shower or naming ceremony gift. Comes in a gift-ready box.
materials: 100% organic cotton yarn (dye-free options available)
care: Hand wash in mild baby detergent. Dry flat.

name: Organic Baby Blanket
description: Wrap your little one in pure love. Our Organic Baby Blanket is hand-crocheted in a classic shell stitch using certified organic cotton. Lightweight yet warm — perfect for all seasons. Can be personalised with the baby's name embroidered in the corner.
materials: GOTS-certified organic cotton yarn
care: Machine wash on delicate at 30°C. Tumble dry low.

name: Yarn Ball Keychain
description: A pocket-sized piece of handmade joy! Our Yarn Ball Keychain is crocheted tightly over a foam ball for a satisfying squish. Clip it to your bag, keys, or use it as a zipper pull. Makes the most adorable, affordable gift.
materials: Cotton yarn, foam ball, metal keyring
care: Spot clean only.

name: Boho Tassel Earrings
description: Statement earrings handcrafted with tiny crochet flowers and cotton thread tassels on gold-toned hooks. Lightweight and hypoallergenic. Each pair is unique — tiny imperfections are part of the charm! Great for gifting.
materials: Mercerised cotton thread, gold-toned brass hooks (hypoallergenic)
care: Keep away from water. Store in a cool, dry place.

name: Strawberry Amigurumi Keychain
description: Impossibly cute, this Strawberry Amigurumi Keychain will make everyone smile. Hand-crocheted with seed-stitch detailing on the red body and a fluffy green crown. Attached to a sturdy metal keyring. Great stocking stuffer or birthday gift.
materials: Cotton yarn, polyester fiberfill, metal keyring
care: Spot clean only.

name: Mandala Cushion Cover
description: Transform your living space with our hand-crocheted Mandala Cushion Cover. Worked in the round using a traditional mandala motif, each cover is a miniature work of art. Envelope closure at the back. Insert not included.
materials: 100% cotton yarn, envelope closure
care: Machine wash on delicate. Dry flat.

name: Summer Bucket Hat
description: Stay sun-kissed in style with our handcrafted Summer Bucket Hat. Made from 100% cotton yarn in a tightly crocheted weave that provides shade and breathability. Foldable for travel. The perfect festival, beach, or picnic accessory.
materials: 100% combed cotton yarn
care: Hand wash only. Reshape while damp and air dry.

name: Lace Table Runner
description: Add timeless elegance to your dining table with our Lace Table Runner. Handcrafted in a delicate pineapple-stitch pattern using fine mercerised cotton thread. Available in multiple lengths. A beautiful wedding or housewarming gift.
materials: Fine mercerised cotton thread (10/2)
care: Hand wash with mild detergent. Iron on cool while damp.

name: Baby Rattle Amigurumi
description: Engage your baby's senses with our soft and colourful Baby Rattle Amigurumi. A crocheted plush with a gentle bell inside creates a soothing sound. No hard edges, all safety-tested. Choose from a bear, duck, or bunny shape.
materials: Hypoallergenic cotton yarn, polyester fiberfill, rattle insert
care: Surface wash only. Do not submerge.

name: Phone Pouch Wristlet
description: Leave your big bag at home! Our Phone Pouch Wristlet comfortably holds your smartphone, cards, and a few notes. Crocheted in a dense mesh pattern with a secure zipper top and wrist loop. Perfect for evenings out.
materials: Cotton yarn, metal zipper, wrist strap
care: Spot clean only. Keep away from moisture.

name: Crochet Hair Scrunchie Set
description: Elevate your hair game with our adorable Crochet Scrunchie Set. Three scrunchies in complementary colours made from silky cotton yarn over a wide elastic band. Gentle on hair, no pulling or breakage. Makes a super cute gift set!
materials: Soft cotton yarn, wide elastic band
care: Hand wash in cool water. Dry flat.

name: Dino Plushie Amigurumi
description: RAWR! Meet our Dino Plushie, the friendliest prehistoric creature you'll ever meet. Handcrafted in a chunky crochet stitch with spiky back ridges, smiley expression, and a wonderfully squishy body. A firm favourite for kids and collectors alike.
materials: Soft acrylic yarn, polyester fiberfill, safety eyes
care: Machine wash on delicate cold. Tumble dry low.

name: Coastal Raffia Beach Bag
description: Head to the beach in style with our Coastal Raffia Beach Bag. Hand-crocheted from natural raffia with a canvas lining and two interior pockets. Spacious enough for towels, sunscreen, and snacks. Comes with a detachable pouch.
materials: Natural raffia, canvas lining, wooden handles
care: Spot clean only. Store in a cool, dry place.

name: Lovey Security Blanket
description: A newborn's best friend. Our Lovey Security Blanket combines a soft crocheted mini-blanket with an attached amigurumi animal head (choose from bunny, bear, or elephant). The perfect soothing companion for sleep and travel.
materials: Organic cotton yarn, polyester fiberfill, safety eyes
care: Machine wash on delicate at 30°C. Tumble dry low.

name: Personalised Name Keychain
description: Give the gift of a name! Our hand-crocheted letter keychains can be linked together to spell any name or word up to 8 characters. Each letter is individually stuffed and finished with a secure keyring. Totally unique and totally adorable.
materials: Cotton yarn, polyester fiberfill, metal keyring
care: Spot clean only.
